title: South Florida Plans This Week
igCaption:
Save these Miami plans before Halloween.
Oct. 21 to Nov. 1, Miami, free to $52

Sources: Miami Herald, WSVN, Yahoo, Miami New Times, WPEC, NBA.com, NHL.com

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #MiamiGuide #HalloweenMiami

scenes.text: A celebrity cafe just opened in Wynwood, and Brightline brought back a Heat train this week.
Machine Gun Kelly opened his Miami cafe in Wynwood. WSVN called it a coffee shop and bar, and Yahoo described it as unapologetically authentic.
scenes.caption: Machine Gun Kelly opened his Miami cafe in Wynwood. WSVN called it a coffee shop and bar, and Yahoo described it as unapologetically authentic.

scenes.text: Brightline brought back its Miami HEAT Buzzer Beater train service for the 2026 to 2027 season. The Heat opened the season Oct. 21 against the Minnesota Timberwolves.
scenes.caption: Brightline brought back its Miami HEAT Buzzer Beater train service for the 2026-27 season. The Heat opened the season Oct. 21 against the Minnesota Timberwolves.

scenes.text: The Florida Panthers and Jameson brought back Cats on Tap for the 2026 to 2027 season. It is a drink special tied to Panthers games. If you're at Cats on Tap, check NEAR for Panthers fans nearby.

scenes.text: The Horrorland is back for its seventh season at Jungle Island. It runs Thursday through Sunday from 7 to 10 p.m. through Nov. 1, with tickets at $39.99.
scenes.caption: The Horrorland is back for its 7th season at Jungle Island. It runs Thursday through Sunday from 7 to 10 p.m. through Nov. 1, with tickets at $39.99.

scenes.text: Sounds of Screams debuts this year at the Miami-Dade Fair Expo Center. It covers 13 acres, and one ticket includes five haunted houses, carnival rides, scare zones, and live entertainment.

scenes.text: Which one are you saving for this week? It is funny how a week can feel packed with places and still leave you wondering who you kept seeing around town; NEAR turns those crossed paths into names.
